author: Today I Found Out
description:
In this weekend's compilation video, we're looking at who the first and second reich's were, if both the axis and allies in WWII were really powered by meth, how the heck Winston Churchill lost the election directly after Germany's defeat, that time Hitler had soldiers dress up as Polish soldiers and attack Germany so he could use it as an excuse to attack Poland, whether it's true the allies could have crushed Germany at the very start of WWII, what was up with the weird spiky german helmets, and WW1's biggest myth.

51:59 How on Earth Did Winston Churchill Lose the Election Directly Following Germany's Defeat
1:16:30 Forgotten History: That Time Hitler Secretly Attacked Germany to Justify the Invasion of Poland

title: Hitler's was the Third Reich... So Who Were the First and Second?
